reviews.text: I always ask you to look after my child temporarily. I always look forward to reading your diary, which is filled with lots of adorable photos. The shop is very clean, and the staff are polite and kind. Thank you so much as always.

Loaf had a wonderful time at DOG ONE PLUS hotel! It was her first time in a dog hotel, and while she was naturally restless the first night, she enjoyed herself the next two days! I appreciate the team’s regular updates via Line, and the photos and videos shared to put my anxiety at ease. Will definitely return!

I used their pet hotel service.

I received daily updates, photos, and videos via LINE, which was reassuring as I could see how my dog ​​was doing during his stay.

He had plenty of time to interact with other dogs, and my dog, who loves both people and other dogs, seemed very happy.

I would like to use their services again, not just the hotel, but also their obedience training classes.

Our dog always looked forward to going to school. At first, he was restless, but as he continued attending, he gradually learned to stay still. We also enjoyed reading the school journal and reading the photos each time. We'd like to enroll him in the advanced course as well.


May 2026 Update ↓
He graduated from the advanced course!

Unlike the puppy class, he challenged himself with even more difficult techniques. He can now lie down and stay for extended periods. The journal provides detailed reports on each day's lesson, so we understand how the lessons are progressing. We also participated in the walking lessons with our dog and learned tips for walking properly.

Our dog loves the instructors and his friends at the school, and he seems to have a lot of fun every time!

This was my first time using a pet hotel.

I was worried and anxious, but I was able to check on my pet via 24-hour live camera, and the staff even sent me photos of my pet, which was great.

I would definitely use their services again if the opportunity arises.

I have been using their grooming, hotel and kindergarten services since they opened. The staff are all very kind and keep me updated on how they are doing, so I feel at ease. I also feel at ease knowing that I can see the camera. At the hotel, my dog ​​enjoys playing with his friends during the day and sleeps soundly on his back at night. I am grateful for their thoughtful attention to detail.

I used your pet hotel, and the service was very polite and reassuring from start to finish.

The explanations before leaving my pet were easy to understand, and they listened carefully to my concerns and requests, so I was able to trust them and leave my pet in their care.

I also really appreciated the fact that they kept me updated on how my pet was doing throughout its stay with photos and messages.

They provided detailed updates such as "This is how he's doing now" and "He's eating well," so I felt safe even when I was away and didn't have to worry.

I could tell that the staff treated my pet with love, and I was very impressed by how relaxed he looked when he returned.

I felt that this was a pet hotel that I could trust wholeheartedly to leave my precious family member with.

I would definitely use your services again.
The shop is beautiful and the cuts are always cute. Thank you so much! My dog ​​loves coming here too!

We used your services for a 2-night, 3-day hotel stay! Thanks to the considerate way you handled our shy dog ​​(who is wary of both people and other dogs), she seemed to have a great time at the dog run. All the photos you sent showed her with a big smile, which gave us great peace of mind! Thank you so much! ✨

It was great to be able to see how my child was doing through photo sharing and monitoring cameras.

Also, I appreciated you reporting any changes in my child's health.

My small dog, who has boundless energy even with just walks and playing at home, sleeps soundly and content after coming home from the school, thanks to the mentally stimulating and engaging play sessions with the trainers.

Above all, it's a wonderful place where the trainers are genuinely caring towards pet owners, and the friendly staff welcome you with smiles.
Thank you very much for using Dog One Plus Azabu Juban store. We are very happy to receive your positive review. We look forward to seeing you again.

I always use the school. All the staff are kind and polite, and I'm very grateful for that. They also take into consideration the compatibility between dogs, so my dog ​​seems to have met many friends. I feel that this is an environment where I can leave my dog ​​in their care with peace of mind, regardless of their personality.

My 6mth old mini dachshund has been going for a month here. And she loves it. Everyone who works there is super friendly and they even do a digital daily diary so you can see what your dog has been up to. It’s clean and I recommend it.

We use their playschool, and all the staff are incredibly kind. They treat my child gently, and I'm always grateful.

They're attentive not only to my child but also to the owner, so I feel completely at ease leaving my child in their care.

The best school for my maltipoo puppy. She really loves coming here and has made lots of friends. The staff is very welcoming and the trainers are friendly and professional, they take very good care of my Didi. The highlight is coming to pick her up and seeing how happy she is.

We always use your hotel and daycare services!

All the staff are very kind and you can tell they love dogs, so I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​with them.

There's none of that typical pet shop dog smell, and I think they keep everything very clean.

We look forward to continuing to use your services in the future. 🙇🏻‍♀️

I use your services all the time!

The staff are so kind, and I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​with them!
It was convenient to be able to request training and grooming during my stay.
I used their pet hotel service, and I felt very at ease leaving my dog ​​there because I could see the camera in his room 24 hours a day ✨
The staff are very friendly, and I feel completely at ease leaving my pet in their care. The photo report after grooming is also a nice touch!
I've used this hotel during my travels, and they've always provided excellent service. The fact that I can view my room via camera is also reassuring.
My dog ​​looks absolutely adorable after the grooming. The cashmere treatment made her fur so much healthier, which I'm very happy about.

I occasionally use their services for overnight stays and grooming.
I appreciate that each room has a camera.
They send me daily reports with photos of my pet eating, using the toilet, and playing, so I can leave my pet there with peace of mind.

Since it opened, we've been using it for daytime boarding, hotel stays, and grooming. 

The staff are all kind and polite, and they're also able to assess how dogs get along with each other, so it seems we've made lots of good friends. 🐾
I feel like I can leave my dog ​​with them, no matter what their personality is.

I've used a lot of hotels and grooming salons in the past, but DOG ONE PLUS is the first salon where I'm completely satisfied with the facilities, service, and prices, and can leave everything to them.

It's become a second home for my dog. 🏠✨ It's the only salon that both my dog ​​and I can truly trust.

Our two dogs are always well taken care of here. Both of them seem to love this school and the trainers, and they're always overjoyed when they step inside!

One of our dogs, whom we adopted later, spent a long time at the pet shop, but after enrolling immediately after we brought him home, he's become able to play well with other dogs, something he used to be afraid of.

Our other dog is gradually maturing, and as different challenges began to emerge, he started attending the advanced course again, and as expected, those challenges are being resolved.

The fact that they have multiple locations and various systems and structures is reassuring for us as pet owners. 😌

I always trust them because I can check on what's happening in the room at any time with a pet camera and they send me regular report diaries with photos, which gives me great peace of mind.
I also asked them to provide their lessons when I first started, and the instructor was very kind.
This was my second time getting my dog ​​groomed, and the last time they gave him a really cute cut and even took photos, which made me so happy that I asked them to do it again.

I'm sure my dog ​​will be happy and secure here, so I'd love to have them do it again when I'm away from home!
